changes: Within a report section, identical analysis executionSpec plus exact application-generated suffix is rendered once. Original prose, separate claim identity, conditions and citations are preserved.
Different configurations remain visible even if their rendered assumptions happen to look identical. Altered suffixes and original trailing sentences are not stripped.
An inconclusive experiment now says no verified experimental plan has been formed, rather than automatically blaming insufficient source evidence.

Shared synthesis/repair/review requirements call for reproducible operations or exact algorithm references, prescribed order or justified commutation, concrete control settings and explicit seed aggregation. A proposed null hypothesis is distinguished from a claim of proven additivity.

offlineReplay.input: Actual immutable deep_research_publications_v2 payload read from SQLite
offlineReplay.measurementCorrection: An initial simplified payload probe omitted publication fields and measured 613 characters; that value is discarded. Actual publication comparison removes only the repeated generated protocol.

limitations: Free-prose overlap is retained; no semantic summarization or hidden alteration of original claims.
Stronger scientific guidance is not proof of real model adherence.
Rendering improvements do not establish experimental correctness or complete DR0-DR5 acceptance.
